results.title: Europe Automotive Glass 2026-2031 - Advanced Glazing and ADAS Integration Create Growth Opportunities
results.description: Opportunities center on panoramic roofs, HUD/ADAS-ready windshields, smart and acoustic glazing, solar integration and aftermarket services; high costs hinder mass adoption.
